components.name: Context save
components.description: Teal save action with a contrasting ink hover state.

components.name: Run search
components.html: <label class="ds-field">Find a run<input type="search" placeholder="Search by run name"></label>
components.css: .ds-field{display:grid;gap:6px;color:var(--ink-faint);font:.75rem system-ui}.ds-field input{min-height:40px;padding:0 10px;border:1px solid var(--rule);border-radius:6px;background:var(--surface);color:var(--ink);font:.85rem system-ui}.ds-field input:hover{border-color:var(--rule-strong)}.ds-field input:focus-visible{outline:3px solid var(--blue);outline-offset:3px}

components.name: Section navigation
components.description: Text anchors with a visible current section.
components.html: OverviewPlanRuns
components.css: .ds-nav{display:flex;gap:4px;font:650 .84rem system-ui}.ds-nav a{padding:10px 12px;border-radius:5px;color:var(--ink-soft);text-decoration:none}.ds-nav a:hover,.ds-nav a[aria-current]{background:var(--paper-deep)}.ds-nav a:focus-visible{outline:3px solid var(--blue);outline-offset:3px}

components.name: Planning disclosure
components.description: A native disclosure keeps optional forms available without filling the initial view.
components.html:
Goal & availabilityPersonalize your week

Weekly mileage and available running days.
components.css: .ds-disclosure{border-top:1px solid var(--rule);color:var(--ink);font:.85rem system-ui}.ds-disclosure summary{padding:16px 2px;cursor:pointer;font-weight:700}.ds-disclosure summary span{display:block;margin-top:5px;color:var(--ink-faint);font-size:.76rem;font-weight:400}.ds-disclosure summary:hover{color:var(--teal)}.ds-disclosure summary:focus-visible{outline:3px solid var(--blue);outline-offset:4px}
